extracted.intended_audience: members of the public, landowners, surveyors, or other parties wishing to protest the Bureau of Land Management's official filing of plats of survey (South Dakota)
extracted.subtask_description: Procedures and requirements for filing a written notice of protest to the Bureau of Land Management regarding proposed official filing of plats of survey, including deadlines, required contents, where to file, and effects of timely or untimely protests.

rubrics_metrics.name: Deadline for receipt of notice of protest
rubrics_metrics.description: A person or party who wishes to protest this decision must file a notice of protest in time for it to be received in the BLM Montana State Office no later than May 1, 2024.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: The date in the DATES section (May 1, 2024) is the cutoff for receipt; protests received after that date may be untimely (see untimely protest criterion).

rubrics_metrics.name: Form and content of notice of protest
rubrics_metrics.description: The notice of protest must be a written notice of protest and must identify the plat(s) of survey that the person or party wishes to protest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A written notice should clearly state which plat(s) are being protested and be filed with the BLM Chief Cadastral Surveyor for South Dakota at the address in the ADDRESSES section of the notice.

rubrics_metrics.name: Filing time when received after business hours
rubrics_metrics.description: If received after regular business hours, a notice of protest will be considered filed the next business day.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parties should account for office hours when ensuring timely filing; electronic or late-day physical deliveries may be treated as next-business-day filings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Statement of reasons deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: A written statement of reasons in support of the protest, if not filed with the notice of protest, must be filed with the BLM Chief Cadastral Surveyor for South Dakota within 30 calendar days after the notice of protest is received.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If you file only a notice initially, you have 30 calendar days from receipt of that notice by BLM to submit supporting reasons; include reasons with the initial notice to avoid a separate filing.

rubrics_metrics.name: Effect of timely protest — stay of official filing
rubrics_metrics.description: If a notice of protest of the plat(s) of survey is received prior to the scheduled date of official filing or during the 10-calendar-day grace period provided in 43 CFR 4.401(a) and the delay in filing is waived, the official filing of the plat(s) of survey identified in the notice of protest will be stayed pending consideration of the protest.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: A timely protest (or one within the CFR grace period when delay is waived) prevents the plats from being officially filed until the protest is resolved.

rubrics_metrics.name: Decision on protest and subsequent filing schedule
rubrics_metrics.description: Upon receipt of a timely protest, and after a review of the protest, the Authorized Officer will issue a decision either dismissing or otherwise resolving the protest. A plat of survey will then be officially filed 30 days after the protest decision has been issued in accordance with 43 CFR part 4.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: After resolution, official filing resumes and occurs 30 days following the protest decision; parties should monitor for the Authorized Officer's decision to know the new filing date.

rubrics_metrics.name: Untimely protest consequence
rubrics_metrics.description: If a notice of protest is received after the date described in the DATES section and the 10-calendar-day grace period provided in 43 CFR 4.401(a), the notice of protest will be untimely, may not be considered, and may be dismissed.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Late protests risk dismissal and likely will not delay the official filing of plats; ensure compliance with DATES and applicable CFR grace periods.

rubrics_metrics.name: Public availability of submissions (personal information warning)
rubrics_metrics.description: Before including your address, phone number, email address, or other personal identifying information in a notice of protest or statement of reasons, you should be aware that the documents you submit—including your personal identifying information—may be made publicly available in their entirety at any time.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: You may ask for withholding of personal identifying information from public review, but the BLM cannot guarantee it will be able to do so; consider redacting unnecessary personal data if appropriate and permitted.

rubrics_metrics.name: Where and how to obtain or view the plats
rubrics_metrics.description: A copy of the plats may be obtained from the Public Room at the BLM Montana State Office, 5001 Southgate Drive, Billings, Montana 59101, upon required payment. The plats may be viewed at this location at no cost.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Parties wishing to inspect the plats should visit the Public Room (pay for copies if desired) or contact the office for access details prior to filing a protest.

rubrics_metrics.name: Contact information and accommodations for further information
rubrics_metrics.description: For further information contact Joshua Alexander, BLM Chief Cadastral Surveyor for South Dakota; telephone: (406) 896-5123; email: jalexand@blm.gov. Individuals in the United States who are deaf, deafblind, hard of hearing, or have a speech disability may dial 711 (TTY, TDD, or TeleBraille) to access telecommunications relay services for contacting Mr. Alexander. Individuals outside the United States should use the relay services offered within their country to make international calls to the point-of-contact in the United States.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Use the listed contact to clarify filing procedures, office hours, or to request accommodations; relay services are available for certain disabilities and international callers should use local relay offerings.

rubrics_metrics.name: Scheduled official filing timing absent protest
rubrics_metrics.description: The plats of surveys for the lands described in this notice are scheduled to be officially filed 30 calendar days after the date of this publication in the BLM Montana State Office, Billings, Montana.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This is the default filing schedule; a timely protest can stay this filing as described in the 'Effect of timely protest' criterion.

rubrics_metrics.name: Authority and applicable regulations cited
rubrics_metrics.description: The notice cites legal authority and procedural regulations relevant to filing and protest: (Authority: 43 U.S.C. chapter 3) and references 43 CFR 4.401(a) and 43 CFR part 4.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Protests and filing actions will be handled in accordance with these statutes and CFR provisions; parties should consult these provisions for detailed procedural rules and rights.
